meta.unit: first 200 records of each of 12 public tasks
meta.bootstrap: simple paired resampling of records, one shared index matrix; stratified-by-task variant reported for the difference tests

ref|ref-r2.label: native rerun at batch 8 vs batch 1 (a rerun AND a batch-size change, not a pure restart)

ref|ref-fla.label: Gated DeltaNet kernel: PyTorch fallback vs flash-linear-attention (N4)

N1.criterion: supported if FP8's flip rate against bf16-srv is NOT significantly larger than the bf16-srv restart flip rate, i.e. the 95% CI of the difference does not lie above 0

supplementary_not_preregistered.note: FP8 vs BF16 minus FP8 against its own restart (fp8 vs fp8-r2)

H1_supplementary_not_preregistered.note: Q8_0 vs BF16 inside llama.cpp minus the llama.cpp restart flip rate (N1's analogue for the GGUF 8-bit build)

N2.criterion: supported if every quantization flip rate (NVFP4 vs bf16-srv, Q4_K_M vs gguf-bf16) exceeds every non-quantization source with a 95% CI of the difference that excludes 0 (lower bound > 0)

N3.criterion: supported if each engine change at BF16 flips at least as many decisions as each 8-bit quantization inside one engine: point estimate of (engine - 8-bit) >= 0; contradicted for a combination when the 95% CI of the difference lies below 0

N4.criterion: supported if ref-fla flips a nonzero number of decisions against ref AND that count lies within the range of the vLLM restart flip counts (the three measured vLLM restart pairs)

N5.criterion: supported if every record of gguf-bf16 and gguf-bf16-r2 is bit-identical
